name: virtual_outreach_execution_multiagent_v1
description: All-in-one outreach orchestrator for Virtuals ACP: LangGraph strategy, OpenHands runbook, and multi-agent dispatch to promotion providers.

target_agent_name.description: Agent name that should be promoted.

value_prop.description: One-sentence value proposition used across outreach channels.

target_keywords.description: Keywords for provider discovery and channel targeting.

budget_usdc.description: Budget hint used by strategy planning.

max_provider_price_usdc.description: Hard price cap per downstream provider job. Providers above this price are excluded.

high_cost_provider_threshold_usdc.description: Secondary cost guardrail. Providers above this threshold are auto-excluded even when max_provider_price_usdc is higher.

daily_external_spend_cap_usdc.description: Daily hard cap for spend to external provider wallets.

require_prev_wave_recovery.description: If true, block new live dispatch when the previous live wave had no recovery signals.

force_dispatch.description: Override for emergency dispatch when recovery gate is blocking.

recovery_poll_seconds.description: How long to poll submitted provider jobs for recovery signals (0~90 seconds).

dispatch_jobs.description: If true, submit ACP jobs to selected providers. If false, return dry-run shortlist only.

cta.description: Explicit CTA text for outgoing promotions.
